programme.title: Genesis: Three Sides Live
programme.desc: Three Sides Live was filmed in November 1981 on the Abacab tour in North America. Originally filmed in 16mm, the footage has now been fully restored. The show focuses on tracks from the Duke and Abacab albums.

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Roustabout
programme.desc: Elvis is a karate-chopping biker who’s hired as a carnival Roustabout. At first, he just provides muscle and a diversion for the beautiful carny girls. Then he picks up a guitar and gets the midway rockin’.

programme.title: The Skull
programme.desc: The skull of the Marquis de Sade has been taken from its grave, bringing terror to those who own it. Demonologist Christopher Maitland is eager to add the piece to his occult collection.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Dark Tide
programme.desc:
Kate accepts a lucrative opportunity to lead a thrill-seeking millionaire businessman on a shark dive in the most dangerous waters, outside the cage.
PG-13

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Denzel Washington stars in this spell-binding thriller as the Chief of Police of a small town who finds himself caught in the eye of a storm as he investigates the murder of a woman he was secretly seeing….because all the evidence points to him!

programme.title: Merantau
programme.desc: Leaving the simple life in rural West Sumatera, Yuda must undergo merantau, the traditional rite of passage in which a young man must leave his family’s home to make it on his own.

programme.title: The Raid: Redemption
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Jakarta's slums lies a drug-gang’s safe house, home to some of the most terrifying and ruthless fighters in the city. Arriving before dawn, an elite swat team moves in to take down the notorious drug lord that runs it.

programme.title: The Raid 2 (Subtitled)
programme.desc: Following immediately after the events of THE RAID, Rama (Iko Uwais) is forced to reinvent himself as an undercover cop in order to provide protection for his wife and child.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Superstar Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) teams up with Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) for a hilarious, action-packed thrill ride. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) also stars as an ultra-sexy secret agent. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Dead Again
programme.desc: On the day a police sergeant sends a young recruit fresh out of police academy, all hell breaks loose as both officers must fight for survival.

programme.title: The Night Watchmen
programme.desc: Four inept night watchmen and a fearless tabloid journalist, fight a a horde of hungry vampires to save themselves but also the City of Baltimore. Some men were born heroes but not these guys.

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods has it all, but when her boyfriend goes to Harvard, Ellie rallies all her resources to get into Harvard Law. But law school is a far cry from the comforts of home. Elle must wage the battle of her life, for herself and for all blondes!

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Center Stage
programme.desc: The American Ballet Company is not for the fainthearted, it's for the most gifted and beautiful ballet dancers alive. But you'll need more than mere physical prowess and determination to succeed. PG-13

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Past Lives

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Green Day: Live at Fox Theater
programme.desc: Green Day performs from "21st Century Breakdown", at the Fox Theater in the band's hometown, Oakland, California.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas; the festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Moby Dick (1956)
programme.desc: This stellar retelling of Melville's classic is unsurpassed in entertainment, imagination and high adventure. Consumed by an insane rage, Captain Ahab (Gregory Peck) has but one purpose in life - revenge on the great white whale who disfigured him.

programme.title: Dr. Who and the Daleks
programme.desc: Dr. Who accidently sends himself and his granddaughters to a mysterious planet, named Skaro.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since Barrow, Alaska’s population was decimated by vampires. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been travelling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Denzel Washington stars in this spell-binding thriller as the Chief of Police of a small town who finds himself caught in the eye of a storm as he investigates the murder of a woman he was secretly seeing….because all the evidence points to him!

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: The Raid 2 (Subtitled)
programme.desc: Following immediately after the events of THE RAID, Rama (Iko Uwais) is forced to reinvent himself as an undercover cop in order to provide protection for his wife and child.

programme.title: Merantau
programme.desc: Leaving the simple life in rural West Sumatera, Yuda must undergo merantau, the traditional rite of passage in which a young man must leave his family’s home to make it on his own.

programme.title: Bad City
programme.desc: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods has it all, but when her boyfriend goes to Harvard, Ellie rallies all her resources to get into Harvard Law. But law school is a far cry from the comforts of home. Elle must wage the battle of her life, for herself and for all blondes!

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Now a rising lawyer, Elle Woods is about to make partner at her firm, she and Emmett are still love, and her hair is still healthy. Elle heads to D.C. and take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Uptown Girls
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Center Stage
programme.desc: The American Ballet Company is not for the fainthearted, it's for the most gifted and beautiful ballet dancers alive. But you'll need more than mere physical prowess and determination to succeed. PG-13

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

programme.title: Honeymoon
programme.desc: Young newlyweds Paul (Harry Treadaway) and Bea (Rose Leslie) travel to a remote lake cottage for their honeymoon, the promise of private romance awaits them. Shortly after arriving, Paul finds Bea wandering and disoriented in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: A group of medical researchers discover a way to bring dead patients back to life.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Nora & Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrest apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Decades later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Ugly
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood portrays the invincible 'Man With No Name' in lethal pursuit of $200,000 in Confederate money alongside Lee Van Cleef and Eli Wallach in this renowned, influential, and classic cinematic western directed by the great Sergio Leone.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Labyrinth

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - American Landing : Live at Monterey
programme.desc: In June 1967, Jimi Hendrix's U.S. debut at the Monterey Pop Festival was a cultural turning point. Famously setting his guitar ablaze, the performance propelled the Jimi Hendrix Experience to international rock royalty.

programme.title: Michael Kiwanuka: Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: Watch Michael Kiwanuka's performance at the Garorock Festival in 2017.

programme.title: Milky Chance - Live Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-awaited, album Blossom.

programme.title: Moby Dick (1956)
programme.desc: This stellar retelling of Melville's classic is unsurpassed in entertainment, imagination and high adventure. Consumed by an insane rage, Captain Ahab (Gregory Peck) has but one purpose in life - revenge on the great white whale who disfigured him.

programme.title: Dr. Who and the Daleks
programme.desc: Dr. Who accidently sends himself and his granddaughters to a mysterious planet, named Skaro.

programme.title: Dr. Who: Daleks' Invasion Earth 2150 A.D.
programme.desc: In the year 2150, the Earth is subjected to a ferocious Dalek invasion, bombarded with meteorites and cosmic rays. A brilliant scientist, Dr. Who, is transported into the future by a time and space machine. He arrives determined to destroy the Daleks…

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since Barrow, Alaska’s population was decimated by vampires. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been travelling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Dead Presidents
programme.desc: A Vietnam vet, drawn to crime after the war, plans the ultimate heist.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Merantau
programme.desc: Leaving the simple life in rural West Sumatera, Yuda must undergo merantau, the traditional rite of passage in which a young man must leave his family’s home to make it on his own.

programme.title: Bad City
programme.desc: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

programme.title: Bangkok Dog
programme.desc: Special agent Andrew Kang intercepts a drug shipment and goes undercover in Bangkok's criminal underworld. Posing as a cartel operative, he must gain the gang's trust, but as the lines blur, he risks losing himself—and his way out.

programme.title: Uptown Girls
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Blended
programme.desc: After a disastrous blind date, single parents Jim and Lauren never want to see each other again. But when they each sign up separately for a family vacation, they find themselves stuck sharing a suite at a luxurious African safari resort.

programme.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting
programme.desc: A hilarious and heartfelt big-screen comedy about five couples whose intertwined lives are turned upside down by the challenges of impending parenthood.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Huntington Hills High and that means one thing: Party! In one epic night, hearts will be broken, and new romances will blossom for six teens facing the rest of their lives - but not until the party ends!

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: A group of medical researchers discover a way to bring dead patients back to life.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Simmy Tong is an ordinary cabbie-turned-chauffeur who slips into a 2-billion-dollar, super-spy suit and inadvertently becomes a dashing secret agent.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers (2011)
programme.desc: A gifted ensemble cast sparks this bold retelling of Alexander Dumas’ classic tale of friendship and heroism. With Christoph Waltz as wily Cardinal Richelieu.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Milla Jovovich, Cameron Bright Nick Chinlund and William Fichtner star in this theatrical set in the late 21st century, where some humans have been modified genetically by a vampire-like disease and the world is pushed to the brink of worldwide civil war.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: In Columbia Pictures' heart-racing sci-fi adventure Zathura, two squabbling brothers are propelled into deepest, darkest space while playing a mysterious game they discovered in the basement of their old house.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: When Sabrina uses Libby’s likeness to promote a community service program, the real Libby manages to steal the limelight.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina’s first kiss becomes a test of true love when Harvey is turned into a frog.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Salem enters a cat show to make some fast cash, but Sabrina uncovers a fur-raising scandal.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Love definitely isn’t in the air when Sabrina meets her dad’s new girlfriend.

programme.title: The Exes
programme.desc: Holly's office crush Paul returns to work, and she is determined to find out how he feels about her once and for all. Stuart, sick of doing all the cleaning himself hires a maid, who quickly turns Haskell's life upside down.

programme.title: The Exes
programme.desc: After giving Holly's new boyfriend Paul a hard time, the guys make amends and Paul invites them to the party of a lifetime. But on the way, Stuart discovers that Paul's ex-wife might still be in the picture.

programme.title: The Exes
programme.desc: Desperate to impress her perfect sister Jill, Holly invents an alternative lifestyle for herself that quickly spirals out of control. Meanwhile, the guys are riding high on a "special" dish cooked up by Stuart.

programme.title: The Exes
programme.desc: Phil's client, tennis star Chuck Feeney, stays with the guys to hide from the paparazzi. But Chuck the ladies' man turns out to be more of a man's man. Haskell and Holly compete over who can take better care of pregnant Eden.guest star: Zach Braff

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris

programme.title: Milky Chance - Live Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-awaited, album Blossom.

programme.title: Alabama & Friends - Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band.

programme.title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returns to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970; the group's UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails and Trautman is captured by Russian troops. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Two veterans team up with a pair of rookies to form the most freewheeling S.W.A.T. team ever. Their first assignment: transport an international drug kingpin into federal custody - after he's offered $100 million to anyone who will free him!

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Dead Presidents
programme.desc: A Vietnam vet, drawn to crime after the war, plans the ultimate heist.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Bangkok Dog
programme.desc: Special agent Andrew Kang intercepts a drug shipment and goes undercover in Bangkok's criminal underworld. Posing as a cartel operative, he must gain the gang's trust, but as the lines blur, he risks losing himself—and his way out.

programme.title: Gladiator Underground
programme.desc: Two brothers compete in the world’s deadliest underground fighting tournament where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

programme.title: Tekken
programme.desc: The year is 2039. The world wars have destroyed everything and territories are run by corporations, the mightiest of which is TEKKEN. In the midst of the ruined society, one warrior rises from the streets.

programme.title: Blended
programme.desc: After a disastrous blind date, single parents Jim and Lauren never want to see each other again. But when they each sign up separately for a family vacation, they find themselves stuck sharing a suite at a luxurious African safari resort.

programme.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting
programme.desc: A hilarious and heartfelt big-screen comedy about five couples whose intertwined lives are turned upside down by the challenges of impending parenthood.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Huntington Hills High and that means one thing: Party! In one epic night, hearts will be broken, and new romances will blossom for six teens facing the rest of their lives - but not until the party ends!

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returns to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970; the group's UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Genesis: Three Sides Live
programme.desc: Three Sides Live was filmed in November 1981 on the Abacab tour in North America. Originally filmed in 16mm, the footage has now been fully restored. The show focuses on tracks from the Duke and Abacab albums.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: Sweet Smell of Success
programme.desc: A columnist and a press agent tear into the maelstrom of midtown Manhattan's night creatures in a sinister game that involves money, power and ultimately survival.

programme.title: Seconds
programme.desc: Desperate to escape his life, Arthur succumbs to a mysterious organization's offer of a new identity and a fresh start. Surgically transformed into the handsome, young Tony Wilson, he begins a jet-set existence among a community of "Reborns."

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Two veterans team up with a pair of rookies to form the most freewheeling S.W.A.T. team ever. Their first assignment: transport an international drug kingpin into federal custody - after he's offered $100 million to anyone who will free him!

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: A former DEA agent relocates his family to a small Louisiana town in hopes of starting a new life. There, he finds himself face-to-face with a local drug kingpin out for revenge after discovering the agent's past cases in this crime thriller.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: Species II
programme.desc: A trio of American astronauts become instant heroes as they plant the Stars and Stripes on Mars before beginning the voyage home. But back on their ship, something else has set its sights on Earth, something whose relatives have already paid us a visit.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: The heat is on in this fast-paced action-comedy starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a street smart Detroit cop tracking down his best friend's killer in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: Tekken
programme.desc: The year is 2039. The world wars have destroyed everything and territories are run by corporations, the mightiest of which is TEKKEN. In the midst of the ruined society, one warrior rises from the streets.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: A defenseless man is kidnapped by an organized crime syndicate and turned into a ruthless assassin.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: In a stunning dual role, international action star Jet Li portrays Gabriel Yulaw, a police officer confronted with a sinister form of himself escaped from an advanced, parallel universe and intent on killing Gabriel.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Blended
programme.desc: After a disastrous blind date, single parents Jim and Lauren never want to see each other again. But when they each sign up separately for a family vacation, they find themselves stuck sharing a suite at a luxurious African safari resort.

programme.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting
programme.desc: A hilarious and heartfelt big-screen comedy about five couples whose intertwined lives are turned upside down by the challenges of impending parenthood.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
programme.desc: Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: Burl Ives earned a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his portrayal of a family patriarch involved in a bitter land feud in this explosive western drama that also features a sumptuous musical score.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: Rio Grande
programme.desc: Lt. Col. Yorke leads his cavalry troops to the Rio Grande to fight a warring tribe. Yorke’s toughest battle lies ahead when his unorthodox plan to outwit the elusive Apaches leads to possible court-martial.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After a secret weapon is stolen by the evil Cobra, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Simmy Tong is an ordinary cabbie-turned-chauffeur who slips into a 2-billion-dollar, super-spy suit and inadvertently becomes a dashing secret agent.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: A couple find themselves in over their heads when they foster three children

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops when a mother of two is forced to teach another woman to raise her kids. Julia Roberts and Susan Sarandon star.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: After receiving their DNA test results, Victoria exploits her Native American heritage, Melanie is attracted to her cousin, and Joy and Elka are shocked that they're related.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Bob sends Joy a creepy doll replica of himself, Victoria's agent advises her to do local theater, and Melanie accidentally gives Dane estrogen patches.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: When sleep-deprived Christine tries potent new sleeping pills, she wakes up to discover that she made several embarrassing phone calls while knocked out.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine worries that she has lost her ability to attract men. When Richard's very attractive brother, Joe, kisses her, she feels revitalized--but she finds out a surprising secret about Joe that even Richard doesn't know.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Eager to make a difference, Christine volunteers to collect signatures supporting an issue she doesn't quite understand—as she finds out from a competitive signature-seeker, Audrey.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Intending to send an e-mail about her relationship with Mr. Harris only to Barb, Christine accidentally sends the scandalous message to all of the parents at Ritchie's school.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: When Christine learns that Richard has been hired to remodel Lindsay's bathroom, Christine intervenes to make sure he doesn't screw up the job and risk their reputation at Ritchie's school.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: At the wedding of her ex-boyfriend, Christine agrees to be the designated driver for Richard, New Christine and Barb. But the groom's toast makes her wish she could drink.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina learns not to date outside of her realm after a bad evening with a witch boy.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin
programme.desc: It's Cheech and Chong at their wildest, craziest, most medicated, doing all those zonked-out characters and hilarious routines that put them where they are today: out of the country.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The Wraparound Story concerns a little boy who spins all the tales to distract a witch who wants to pop him in the oven!

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: THE BLOB has returned in this horrific tale about a vile, malignant life-form that crashes to earth in a cozy, rural American town called Arborville. Untroubled by conscience or intellect, the Blob does only one thing-and does it well. Rated: R

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Ash, the sole survivor of THE EVIL DEAD, returns to the same cabin in the woods and again unleashes the dead. With his girlfriend possessed and his body parts running amok, Ash must again single-handedly battle the damned in this unhinged horror classic!

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
programme.desc: A young boy is found wandering without any memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begin to look for clues to help him find his way home.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, Wolfman, Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.desc: Shark busca hincarle el diente a un duelo con Quattro, pero en su lugar se ve envuelto en una batalla submarina con el siniestro hermano de Quattro.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack te presentaremos un top dedicado a algunas de las interpretaciones más memorables. Repasaremos la evolución de una de las sagas más emblemáticas de Xbox: Gears of War y te contaremos todo acerca del origen de adorable Kirby.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este episodio de Expansion Pack, te diremos todo lo que debes saber acerca de la Gamescom, el evento de videojuegos más grande de Europa. Veremos a detalle la trayectoria de Lara Croft; y viajaremos al pasado para recordar al legendario Dino Crisis.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Es hora de iniciar un nuevo nivel de Expansion Pack, conoceremos cómo surge la ESRB, también veremos la evolución de la legendaria saga “Príncipe de Persia”, y echaremos un vistazo a esos juegos que fueron tan buenos que cambiaron a su género.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los Game Awards, en Expansion Pack te volverás experto en uno de los eventos más importantes para el gaming, recordaremos al maravilloso “Pilot Wings 64”, y reconoceremos a los maestros de la música en los videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Conoces las diferencias ente Remaster, Remake y Reboot? En este episodio de Expansion Pack te las contamos. Veremos cómo “Street Fighter”, ha cambiado con el paso de los años; y sentimos el terror con las creepypastas más famosas en videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En México también se desarrollan videojuegos en Expansion Pack, te mostramos algunos, recordamos a una leyenda del PS1, “Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver”, además, hoy conocerás a fondo al polémico Hideo Kojima y viajamos al Tokyo Game Show.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Las leyendas eran ciertas… el Nintendo PlayStation sí existió y en Expansión Pack te contamos el chismecito. “Doom” llega para mostrarnos cómo un clásico puede evolucionar, y los juegos que terminaron siendo muy diferentes a su concepto original.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack recordamos al gran “Conker’s Bad Fur Day”. También te decimos todo lo que hay que saber de Elli de “The Last of Us”, y echamos ojo a las series basadas en videojuegos que hacen honor a las franquicias.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hace muchos anos las mascotas de videojuegos que dominaban el mercado eran 2: Mario de Nintendo y Sonic de SEGA. Esto cambio con Crash Bandicoot en PlayStation. En seguida, te contamos su historia.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar el clasico hit de 2005 desarrollado por SCE Santa Monica Studio para PlayStation 2: God of War.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: Pica destroza a sus oponentes uno tras otro con un gran poder hasta que Zoro lo enfrenta. Pero se trataba de una gran trampa. Dejando a Zoro en un lugar lejano, Pica entra al suelo y empieza un contraataque para eliminar al rey Riku.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: El puño gigante de Pica que casi cubre el cielo desciende sobre el rey Riku. Cuando la esperanza que se encendió en Dressrosa está por aplastarse y otra era de dictadura se acerca, comienza la última batalla de Zoro y Pica.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: Pica, uno de los oficiales, por fin cae, dejando solo a Doflamingo y Trébol. Pero mientras todos confían en Luffy, Bellamy se le opone con su orgullo en juego. Los dos hombres se enfrentan con sus mentes llenas de emoción.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: Aunque está a punto de morir, Law sigue buscando su venganza, pero llega a su fin tras los despiadados disparos de Doflamingo. Cuando Luffy ve el horrible resultado, la última batalla de Dressrosa comienza.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: El plan de exterminio de Doflamingo por fin empieza. La jaula de hilos está cortando Dressrosa. Solo queda una hora. Cuando parece que no quedan esperanzas, se desata un ataque con una sola oportunidad.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: Doflamingo recibe una herida mortal con el ataque de Law, pero el rey absoluto no cae. Cuando va a darle el golpe final a un paralizado Law, Luffy se le enfrenta y la batalla del máximo Haki por fin empieza.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: ¡Luffy enfrenta a Trébol, el último oficial en pie! Pero ninguno de sus ataques con Haki funciona, y se ve contra las cuerdas. Cuando Trébol usa su técnica secreta para acabar con todo, Luffy y Law llegan al límite.

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: ¡Luffy pelea con la ambición de Law y las esperanzas de todos a cuestas, pero los poderosos ataques de Doflamingo lo detienen!

programme.title: One Piece - Dressrosa Saga
programme.desc: La nueva y más poderosa técnica secreta de Luffy estalla finalmente. La habilidad, que aumenta poder, velocidad y todo lo demás, supera a Doflamingo.¡Empieza un violento embate para cambiar las cosas!

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La tía de Yui, Sanako, quien también es propietaria de Atori, ha regresado de un largo viaje al extranjero. A Sanako, al conocer a Ren, no le gusta y lo interrumpe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Sanako, la tía de Yui a la que le gusta mucho Shinji, intenta convencer a los tres (Ren, Yui y Shinji) de que vivan juntos, pero Ren no acepta el acercamiento de Shinji a Yui.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shimada Nanako, el genio informático del ORE Journal, ha sido secuestrado. Shinji recibe instrucciones de encargarse de este incidente y persigue al secuestrador en una casa abandonada en las montañas.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: ¡Misty y Jessie compiten para ser la Reina del Festival de la Princesa! Ash y Brock le prestan a Misty sus Pokémon para la batalla, y Jessie es derrotada a pesar de su Pokémon sorpresa.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Es Día del Niño, y Ash y sus amigos ayudan a unos niños de una escuela a celebrarlo. El Equipo Rocket arruina la diversión llevándose a un niño en vez de a Pikachu. En un asombroso giro de eventos, Meowth se vuelve bueno… ¿o no?

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes viajan a la Isla Cinnabar, donde Ash busca ganar la Medalla Volcán. Un extraño les dice acertijos para llegar al Gimnasio, ¡donde Ash y Pikachu tienen una feroz batalla con un Pokémon que nunca habían visto!

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash finalmente localiza el Gimnasio, ¡suspendido sobre una piscina de lava fundida! Sólo un fuerte Pokémon tipo Fuego puede ayudarlo en esta batalla por la Medalla Volcán, así que Ash debe confiar en su malcriado Charizard.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Mientras Ash y los chicos se apresuran a abordar el último transbordador hacia la Isla Cinnabar, son desviados por un grupo de Squirtle, Wartortle y Blastoise que necesitan su ayuda.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: El Horsea de Misty necesita ejercicio desesperadamente, y los chicos deciden llevarlo al Gimnasio de sus hermanas en Ciudad Celeste. Ahí, ella descubre que sus hermanas están planeando un emocionante ballet bajo el agua.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash, Brock y Misty se desvían camino a Ciudad Viridian cuando todas sus pertenencias desaparecen. Mientras buscan sus cosas perdidas, se ven envueltos en un encuentro cercano que de verdad está fuera de este mundo.

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes llegan a Ciudad Viridian, donde Ash espera ganar la Medalla Tierra. Llegan al Gimnasio justo a tiempo para ver a su rival, Gary, derrotado por un Pokémon desconocido, ¡y Gary insiste en que es maligno!

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: En su camino de vuelta a Pueblo Paleta, nuestros héroes encuentran a un Mr. Mime fugitivo. Ash se disfraza como otro Mr. Mime para poder acercarse. Cuando el Equipo Rocket ataca... ¿atraparán al Mr. Mime correcto?

programme.title: Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes encuentran una desviación en el camino y deciden escalar una escarpada y peligrosa montaña. Pikachu se pierde, y todos deben trabajar juntos para encontrarlo, mantener el calor y enfrentar una tormenta.

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: El Matador

programme.title: Ultimo Viaje a Las Vegas
programme.desc: Cuatro amigos de toda la vida deciden olvidarse de su edad y revivir sus días de gloria cuando el eterno solterón del grupo decide casarse.

programme.title: La llamada de Shanghái

programme.title: Un Destino Compartido
programme.desc: La cómoda vida de un importante agente de talentos de Hollywood se ve amenazada cuando descubre que su mujer le está engañando y que un periodista le ha robado su diario para hundirlo.

programme.title: La Isla De Las Muñecas
programme.desc: Después de ahogarse en una isla muchos años antes, el espíritu maligno de una joven fallecida busca nuevos amigos con quienes jugar, vivos o muertos.

programme.title: Juegos Peligrosos
programme.desc: Madre soltera en tiempos difíciles, le ofrecen un trabajo en un verdadero espectáculo de terror, con una promesa de un millón de dólares al ganador.

programme.title: Muñeca Bruja De Salem

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si tu jornada laboral no fue como esperabas te traemos un capítulo para que te relajes de la presión del día a día, pero eso sí, hazlo en horario laboral. Igual ni te pagan.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: No hay nada como madrugar, para hacer una fila cargando documentos que te tomaron un mes conseguir, solo para que te digan "no hay sistema". Disfruta de estas 5 situaciones del mundo burocrático, porque cuando te pasen, ya no va a ser tan divertido.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Todos hemos hecho algo ridículo por dinero, a veces para costear la cita con el chico de tus sueños y otras simplemente para sobrevivir otro día como adulto. Hoy te traemos seis sketches para que te rías de los gajes del oficio. Dale play al episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: La vida se define por los momentos en los que hiciste realidad lo que parecía imposible. Como lograr que te den la visa gringa. Te traemos seis sketches para rememorar estos momentos de gloria. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¡Trágame tierra! Este episodio está dedicado a los momentos vergonzosos de los que ni tú te libras. No sufras y mejor ríe con estos cinco sketches que traemos para ti. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Crecer es peor que estornudar en tu periodo. De niño seguramente soñabas con crecer, pero para tu sorpresa, ahora solo sales al trabajo y al banco. En este episodio te traemos 6 sketches para que te desquites de las penas de la vida adulta. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro

programme.title: Heidi: La tormenta

programme.title: Heidi: El puente del diablo

programme.title: Heidi: Friedrich

programme.title: Heidi: La silla de ruedas

programme.title: Heidi: Los amigos perdonan

programme.title: Heidi: Edelweiss

programme.title: Heidi: En lo alto de la montaña

programme.title: Heidi: El primer día en la montaña

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM
programme.desc: Tsubasa confía su sueño de ser jugador profesional a Roberto, quien oculta un problema. Gracias al entusiasmo del niño, Rodolfo halla un propósito.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: El Juicio

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: Un Grito Acallado

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: Las Últimas Palabras

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden: Las Habilidades De Kakuzu

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Ayame trajo a Koga para detener la lucha de sus camaradas. Pero ella no tiene intención de regresar a Koga. El monstruo que estaba después de los fragmentos de la Joya Sagrada entonces ataca. Koga lucha para proteger a Kagome y Ayame.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Inuyasha lucha contra el señor del castillo de Ogre. Sanfo oye que Miroku ha ido al sótano con la princesa y lo sigue con el viejo purificador. Kagome encuentra el cadáver de la princesa real en la habitación del señor.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Kikyo se encuentra con Kansuke, un viejo bandido. Kansuke está gravemente enfermo y está tratando de encontrar un lugar para morir. Hace cincuenta años, Onigumo lo convenció de que atacara a una sacerdotisa que protegía la Joya Sagrada.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Inuyasha y la pandilla aceptan un trabajo para deshacerse de los monos, que están destruyendo campos. Se encuentran con tres monos, Gon, Bun y Ken. Los tres son espíritus de mono.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Kagome se resfría y vuelve a la actualidad. Inuyasha está preocupada por ella. Él recoge mucha comida nutritiva. Mientras lo hace, derrota a los demonios que se interponen en su camino.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: El hermano menor de Kagome, Sota, se ha enamorado. Se ha enamorado de Hitomi, uno de sus compañeros de clase. Al principio, le pide a Inuyasha un consejo varonil, pero al final, decide decirle que la ama con un plan orquestado por Kagome.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Tesso, un demonio del ratón que teme a los gatos, se transforma en un curandero y persigue a Kuroro, un Nekomata que lo está molestando. Inuyasha y su banda se encuentran con aldeanos que confunden a Kirara con Kuroro y tratan de ahuyentarla.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Al llegar a Egipto, un helicóptero está esperando a Jotaro y su equipo. Sin embargo, el ayudante que Joseph había solicitado no parece estar en la aeronave.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Avdol diseña un plan para contrarrestar los ataques del Stand de agua, pero el enemigo se les adelanta. Mientras, el supuesto ayudante se queda dormido durante la pelea.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Kakyoin y Avdol buscan tratamiento médico mientras el resto de los hombres entra sin darse cuenta en un bar donde les esperan dos hermanos usuarios de Stand.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Tras encontrar una misteriosa espada, al joven Chaka se le transforma la personalidad. Entretanto, Jotaro y el grupo ponen rumbo a El Cairo.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Joseph y Avdol se quedan atrapados juntos por culpa de un Stand enemigo. Cuando finalmente logran separarse, los pies se les quedan enganchados en las vías del tren.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold le hace una broma a Helga, pero al dejarla ciega, Arnold actúa como sus ojos.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold y Gerald actuarán de banana y fresa en la obra escolar, los cuatro grupos alimenticios, dirigida por Helga. Ellos deciden escapar de la obra y faltar / Arnold accidentalmente arruina la nueva bicicleta de Eugene

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga, accidentalmente, deja caer su libro de poemas de amor de Arnold entre los libros de Gerald y deberá recuperarlo antes de que Arnold descubra quién es la autora / Toda la clase va de paseo al acuario

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.desc: Cuando Sokka siente que no está contribuyendo lo suficiente al grupo, busca a un misterioso maestro que le enseñe todo sobre las espadas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: El Matador

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Un robo a un banco entrelaza las vidas del director de la sucursal, un restaurador, una joven policía embarazada, un policía veterano, y una docena de personas. Vivirán varias horas en compañía de cuatro ladrones con perfiles muy diferentes.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: The Code

programme.title: Un Destino Compartido

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: Parodia de "300" y otras películas. El rey Leónidas y su ejército de 12 hombres luchan contra Jerjes de Persia para defender la libertad de Esparta.

programme.title: Ataque de Los Zombis
programme.desc: Un empleado mediocre de un fabricante de armas debe sobrevivir al caos dentro de la oficina cuando sus colegas se convierten en maníacos asesinos después de tomar una bebida misteriosa.

programme.title: El Secreto de la Mariposa
programme.desc: Ann, una dama solitaria que vive con una colección de mariposas y recuerdos del pasado, se cruza en el camino de la joven Alice, que se dedica a extorsionar a la gente. Ann mantiene un gran misterio sobre su vida y su misteriosa habitación de mariposas.

programme.title: JACK - En la Caja Maldita 2 - El Despertar
programme.desc: Cuando una mujer moribunda abre un juguete antiguo, una caja sorpresa con un payaso adentro, hace un trato con el demonio dentro de ella que curaría su enfermedad a cambio de traer seis víctimas inocentes.

programme.title: Oculus
programme.desc: Una mujer intenta exonerar a su hermano, condenado por asesinato, demostrando que el crimen fue cometido por un fenómeno sobrenatural.

programme.title: Oliver Twist
programme.desc: Una adaptación del clásico cuento de Dickens, donde un huérfano se encuentra con un carterista en las calles de Londres. A partir de ahí, se une a una familia de niños entrenados para robar para su amo.

programme.title: No Dispare
programme.desc: A los 9 años, David perdió a sus padres y a su hermana en una masacre en una tienda y ahora tiene que vivir con sus abuelos. Su abuelo tiene la tarea casi imposible de dar a David una nueva perspectiva de la vida, del futuro.

programme.title: Obsesión
programme.desc: Simon hereda una casa de campo a la que viaja con su familia. Su sueño es renovarla, pero cae en un romance prohibido. Ahora tendrá que estar dispuesta a llegar hasta las últimas consecuencias para recuperar su tranquilidad y a su familia.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Siguiendo el rastro de maletas que contienen dispositivos nucleares, Kane ahora sospecha que su contacto de la CIA puede estar conspirando contra él. Kane sabe que el tiempo corre en su contra.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Cuando Kane y su equipo comienzan a encajar las piezas, se dan cuenta de que no todo es lo que parece.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El FBI ha notado que Kane está tratando de acercarse a su enemigo, The Ghost, y quieren que se detenga.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Cuando Kane se acerca a Magellan, el manejador de Lynch, el agente del FBI Sloan pide de encontrar y arrestar a Kane y a su equipo. Es una carrera contra el tiempo para que el equipo de Kane lo acerque lo suficiente para que Kane dispare a Ghost.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Cuando una afluencia de traficantes de heroína violentos y despiadados desciende sobre Seattle, Elijah Kane lidera un escuadrón de policías encubierto de élite para llevarlos ante la justicia.

programme.title: Jessabelle
programme.desc: Al regresar a su hogar de la infancia en Louisiana para recuperarse de un horrible accidente automovilístico, Jessabelle se encuentra cara a cara con un espíritu atormentado que ha estado esperando su regreso, y no tiene intención de dejarla escapar.

programme.title: Persecución Mortal
programme.desc: El ladrón lleva a cabo el robo de su vida cuando roba al psicótico señor de la droga, Temple. El plan se lleva a cabo sin problemas hasta que el ladrón descubre un polizón en su coche de huida: la esposa embarazada de Temple, Mia.

programme.title: Un dia para sobrevivír
programme.desc: Cuando su avión se estrella en Alaska, seis trabajadores del petróleo son liderados por un hábil cazador para sobrevivir, pero una manada de lobos despiadados los persigue a cada paso.

programme.title: La Sirenita
programme.desc: El periodista Cam Harrison va a investigar la historia de una sirena. Lleva a su sobrina a esta empresa y los dos son testigos de su actuación en un circo. Cam está enamorado de la sirena y la protege cuando el dueño del circo se enfurece por su fuga.

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: Rachel Troyer es una mujer policía en la pintoresca población de Sugarcreek. Con frecuencia visita a sus tías Amish, que la criaron cuando se quedó huérfana. Cuando un vagabundo aparece con su hijo de cinco años, las bondadosas tías insisten en acogerles.

programme.title: Diamante de ilusiones
programme.desc: Mickey Tussler, un lanzador autista, se une a un equipo de béisbol de ligas menores y tiene un profundo efecto en el equipo y en el mánager Arthur "Murph" Murphy en el transcurso de la temporada.

programme.title: Obsesión
programme.desc: Durante su despedida de soltera; Carmen conoce a Kit; un extraño que reaviva las pasiones dentro de ella. A medida que se acerca su boda; se encuentra luchando por mantenerse alejada de Kit.

programme.title: El Doctor y Sus Mujeres
programme.desc: Un guapo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en medio de una crisis de la mediana edad, tiene dificultades con su familia, así como con su propia vida.

programme.title: La llamada de Shanghái
programme.desc: Un abogado de Nueva York e enviado a Shanghái por negocios y pronto se involucra en muchos problemas con la ley.

programme.title: The Wrong Mother
programme.desc: Una enfermera entra a trabajar en la casa de la mujer a quien donó sus óvulos, pero ahora quiere recuperar al hijo que su paciente concibió.

programme.title: The Wrong Nanny
programme.desc: Una mujer contrata a una abuela para que la ayude con sus hijos pequeños, solo para descubrir que la joven es la hija que dio en adopción al nacer.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: La Dra. Jen Richards, una exitosa cirujana plástica, se enreda en la trama de una paciente narcisista cuyo camino hacia la perfección amenaza con destruirla a ella y a su familia.

programme.title: Cuando Yo Te Vuelva a Ver
programme.desc: Treinta años después de haberse radicado en España, Paco regresa a la Argentina para apadrinar la boda de un amigo. Retirado y separado de su esposa española, se reencuentra con sus afectos.

programme.title: De la Misma SangreThrillers
programme.desc: Un policía con gran integridad se ve envuelto en muchos problemas por culpa de su hermano quien trabaja para un poderoso narcotraficante y aunque trata de ocultar el parentesco con su hermano esto no es posible.

programme.title: Deportados

programme.title: Tropicana
programme.desc: El propietario de "Tropicana" cabaret de la habana, envía a su agente y amigo en búsqueda de una joven con las medidas perfectas para que sea la estrella de un nuevo "show" que planea,

programme.title: Tú, Solo Tú
programme.desc: Un joven hombre proveniente del Estado de Jalisco viaja a la capital en busca de su novia Paloma. A su llegada a la capital se sorprende de que su gran amada trabaja como fichera en un cabaret de mala muerte.

programme.title: Una Gallega En La Habana
programme.desc: Candida, una simpatica gallega, decide viajar desde españa a la habana para buscar a su novio de quien no tiene noticias desde hace 20 años.

programme.title: Kickboxer Represalias
programme.desc: Kurt Sloan se ha prometido a sí mismo que no volvería a Tailandia, pero alguien le seda y le obliga a volver al país asiático. Cuando despierta, descubre que está en prisión porque quieren que se enfrente a Mongkut.

programme.title: Kickboxer, la venganza
programme.desc: El legendario luchador de Muay Thai Tong Po asesina sin piedad y en pleno ring a Eric Sloane. Entonces su hermano Kurt Sloane, que siempre ha vivido a la sombra de Eric ve desatado su gran deseo de venganza.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Inspector Eddie Chan es asignado para proteger Wong YatFei, un Rico hombre de negocios. A pesar de los esfuerzos de Eddia, ha secuestrado a Wong.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Una misteriosa nave alienígena realiza un escaneo del Enterprise. Al finalizar, los tripulantes de la nave descubren que han borrado sus memorias, por lo que deberán descubrir quiénes son y donde están. Pero entre ellos hay un impostor...

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Una llamada de auxilio lleva al Enterprise a una zona en la que la última referencia de una nave de la Federación se remonta 2 siglos atrás, cuando desapareció el USS Essex.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf queda paralizado, y con intenciones suicidas. La Dr. Crusher consulta a un investigador, que gusta de tomar altos riesgos, para salvar su vida.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Riker se enamora de un ser androgino después de rescatarlo junto a otros atrapados en un "espacio nulo".

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: La Enterprise queda atrapado en un bucle temporal, pero la tripulación conserva la memoria de instantes previos. Kelsey Grammer participa como actor invitado en el rol de Morgan Bateson.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Wesley es cuestionado sobre un accidente de un vuelo de entrenamiento en la Academia de la Flota Estelar. Ray Walston participa en el papel de Boothby.

programme.title: Los hambrientos

programme.title: Los diablos del terror

programme.title: La red de corrupción

programme.title: La belleza de la vida
programme.desc: Una joven sueña con convertirse en una escritora infantil y encuentra a un vecino, quien se transforma en su mentor.

programme.title: Mi mascota es un león

programme.title: Al filo de la muerte

programme.title: Odio sin Frontera

programme.title: Frozen with Fear
programme.desc: Katharine contrata a Jack, un detective, pues ha visto como asesinaron a su esposo y la policía no encuentra el cuerpo ni algún rastro de su asesinato. Ella envuelta de miedo, comienza a ver cosas extrañas en su casa hasta que aparece su esposo.

programme.title: Hacker

programme.title: Me enamoré de una chica cristiana
programme.desc: Un antiguo narcotraficante se enamora de una mujer muy religiosa, pero su pasado criminal pone en peligro su relación.

programme.title: The Devil's Promise
programme.desc: Mientras la investigación de un profesor universitario sobre sucesos sobrenaturales se ve rechazada, Ibrahim busca desesperadamente una cura para la enfermedad de su esposa.

programme.title: The Devil's Promise
programme.desc: Jennifer encuentra una escena brutal en su casa y descubre marcas demoníacas por todas partes. La salud de Zeina mejora, pero Ibrahim comienza a perder el control.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
